## Core Commercial Services & Pricing Reference
1. **Commercial Car, Van & Box Truck Wraps:**
   - Full Commercial Vehicle Wraps (Cargo Vans, RAM ProMaster, Ford Transit, Sprinters, Pickups, Food Trailers): Starting at $2,450–$3,800 depending on wheelbase and roof coverage.
   - Partial Fleet Wraps & High-Impact Tailgate / Side Graphics: Starting at $950–$1,650.
   - Spot Lettering, USDOT / NC Contractor Door Numbers & Logo Kits: Starting at $275.
2. **Custom T-Shirt Prints & Fort Liberty Military Unit Apparel:**
   - Custom DTF (Direct-to-Film), Dye Sublimation & Heat-Press Apparel for Military Units (PT shirts, deployment/airborne hoodies, hail & farewell shirts), local contractors, and events.
   - Single / Small Batch Custom Shirts: $22–$28 each; Bulk Unit / Crew Bundles (25+ shirts): $12.50–$16.00 each.
3. **Custom Vinyl Decals & Die-Cut Stickers:**
   - Weatherproof laminated UV vinyl window decals, rear-window graphics, and custom die-cut brand stickers.
4. **Large Format Banners & Event Signage:**
   - Heavy-duty 13oz–18oz vinyl banners with reinforced hems and brass grommets, retractable trade-show banners, and military ceremony backdrops.
5. **Removable Commercial Car Magnets:**
   - Heavy-gauge 30-mil vehicle-grade magnetic door signs (HOA-friendly & dual-use personal/work trucks): $85/pair (18"x24").
6. **Professional Business Cards & Marketing Print:**
   - Thick 16pt matte/UV gloss business cards, rack cards, flyers, and door hangers for local trades.
7. **Dye Sublimation & Custom Promotional Merch:**
   - Full-color sublimated tumblers, mugs, metal license plates, patches, and shop gear.
